name: Afghanistan (Kingdom, 1931–1973)
description: A vertical tricolor of black, red and green charged at the centre with the white royal emblem: a mosque with mihrab and minbar within wheat sheaves.
history: The longest-serving Afghan flag, used through Zahir Shah's reign from 1931 until the 1973 republican coup.

features.role: mosque within wheat wreath, inscribed 1348 AH
